items.text: Possessing up to 15 g of cannabis or cannabis resin is not an offence (s 6A), and a household may grow up to four plants.

Smoking cannabis in a public place, including bars, restaurants, clubs and most of a tourist establishment, is an offence: a police warning the first time, a XCD 500 ticket the second, and up to XCD 1,500 on a third (s 6B).
Over 15 g remains a criminal offence under the Misuse of Drugs Act.

laws.rule: Possessing up to 15 g of cannabis or cannabis resin is not an offence (s 6A), and a household may grow up to four plants. Smoking cannabis in a public place, including bars, restaurants, clubs and most of a tourist establishment, is an offence: a police warning the first time, a XCD 500 ticket the second, and up to XCD 1,500 on a third (s 6B). Over 15 g remains a criminal offence under the Misuse of Drugs Act.
